name: Local Ember reusable stock catalog (preview copies)
note: Most images are copies of the Local Ember fleet catalog (licensed iStock, purchased by John Owens and stored at tools/bd-generator/assets/stock/Catalog/). Images are resized to 1600x1067 (3:2) and compressed as WebP for these preview pages. One kinesiology-taping image was added from Pexels because the fleet catalog had no taping photo. Do not use these as live-site originals; keep the fleet catalog as the source of record for licensed iStock files.
